name: Genocider Shou
original_name: ジェノサイダー 翔
source:
Genocide Jack is [url=/c10199]Fukawa Touko[/url]'s murderous and sadistic alternate personality. She only kills handsome men in the same style: crucifies them with her custom scissors. She has tally-marks carved onto her upper thighs, a count of how many people she has killed.

Genocide Jack's appearance is generally the same as Touko's, since they share the same body. However, some features differ: her eyes become red, and she wears a wild facial expression, with her long tongue being out at all times. Her personality is also much wilder.

[Edited from [url=http://danganronpa.wikia.com/wiki/Genocide_Jack]Danganronpa Wikia[/url]]
